ls_fiddler_home.text: I've played the fiddle for sixty years. Weddings, funerals, once a christening in a gale. The wedding fiddler plays all night, and if the bride isn't danced off her feet, it's a poor do.
My granny said the best tunes came from the sea. A fiddler sat in a boat, listening to the waves, would get a rhythm, and the rhythm became a reel. It's a lie, I think. But a good one.
